sn36.4:1.1: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
sn36.4:1.3: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano asantaṃ avijjamānaṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
sn36.4:1.5: sārīrikānaṃ kho etaṃ bhikkhave dukkhānaṃ vedanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ yadidaṃ pātāloti.
sn36.4:1.6: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano sārīrikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati. sammohaṃ āpajjati.
sn36.4:1.7: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano pātāle na paccuṭṭhāsi, gādhañca nājjhagā.
sn36.4:1.8: sutavā bhikkhave ariyasāvako sārīrikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati, na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
sn36.4:1.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako pātāle paccuṭṭhāsi, gādhañca ajjhagāti.
